title: Webhook
description: A standing instruction to call a URL when something happens. The subscription only: what is to be called and for which events. No signing secret travels here — whoever signs a delivery holds the key for it, and a shared shape carrying it would be a secret in every system that read the shape.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

session.description: The session the subscription belongs to, as the system that owns the session names it. Deliveries are scoped by it, and so is who may read the subscription back. Optional: scoping a subscription to a working session is how Creative Flow holds it, not part of what it is, and a system without sessions must be able to carry the same shape.

url.description: Where to post. http or https, as given: a subscription to a URL that no longer answers is still a fact about what was asked for.

events.description: Which events to post. Free text: the names belong to whoever emits them, and a shape that fixed them would go stale the first time one is added.

active.description: Whether it is still being called. Turned off rather than deleted, so the deliveries already made keep pointing at something.
